author: Mark Atwood
text:
[2026-05-11 bundling decision] Confirmed with Mark in interactive triage session 2026-05-11: bundle into the JMAP-g7wu.1 0.2.0 mega-PR.

Rationale: g7wu.1's CallerCtx threading and this bead's extract_account_id clean fix both touch the opening lines of every /set, /copy, /import, /parse handler across 7 extension-server crates. Doing them in separate PRs forces an avoidable merge conflict at every handler. Bundling makes them mechanically independent edits that compose cleanly.

Scope of the clean fix (folded into g7wu.1 mega-PR):
1. Change `extract_account_id` signature in `crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:25` from `(args: &Value) -> Result<Id, JmapError>` to `(args: Value) -> Result<(Id, Map<String, Value>), JmapError>`.
2. Update every handler call site (~30 across mail/chat/calendars/contacts/tasks/filenode/sharing) from:
       let account_id = extract_account_id(&args)?;
       let Value::Object(mut args) = args else { ... };
   to:
       let (account_id, mut args) = extract_account_id(args)?;
3. Improve the error message on non-object input to "arguments must be an object containing accountId" instead of the current misleading "accountId is required" surface.

This is a SemVer break on the canonical jmap-server foundation function — exactly the 0.2.0-class change the bundle is designed for.

Removing `human` label. Implementation rides on g7wu.1's mega-PR.
